name: edictum
description: Edictum, a multiplayer nation simulator, on Firebase Hosting, Auth and Firestore.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-edictum --only firestore "node --test test/rules.test.mjs test/fx-job.test.mjs"
scripts.test:fx: node --test test/fx.test.mjs test/tutorial.test.mjs test/content.test.mjs test/startup.test.mjs test/edict-inbox.test.mjs test/unlock-links.test.mjs test/map-development.test.mjs test/flag-layers.test.mjs test/warehouse.test.mjs test/warehouse-adapter.test.mjs test/navigation-polish.test.mjs test/onboarding.test.mjs test/first-land.test.mjs test/daily-desk.test.mjs test/tab-title.test.mjs test/founding-edict.test.mjs test/assembly-engine.test.mjs test/quiet-tabs.test.mjs test/maps.test.mjs
